display_information.name: Reecog
display_information.description: Helps your team recognize great work in Slack with values, rewards, and real delight.
display_information.long_description:
Reecog offers simple pricing that suits your workspace. Try free for 30 days, no card required!

Turn everyday wins into a culture of appreciation with values-based shoutouts, fun rewards, and a simple setup your team actually uses. 

- Built for employee appreciation in Slack - values-based recognition tool that helps HR & team culture thrive, even for distributed and work from home Slack teams.

- Easy to set up, easy to use - short, intuitive recognition commands and a guided admin setup help your team start in minutes.

- Built around your company values - tag recognition with your values to reinforce the culture you want to grow.

- Rewards that keep it fun - GIF celebrations, points, and a goodies store turn recognition into momentum.

slash_commands.description: Manage recognition points, config, and rewards
